# cycle_autoscale_group (Data Source)

Looks up a Cycle auto-scale group by ID or identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an auto-scale group by ID.
data "cycle_autoscale_group" "by_id" {
  id = "651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21"
}

# Or by its slugged identifier.
data "cycle_autoscale_group" "by_identifier" {
  identifier = "workers"
}

output "asg_maximum" {
  value = data.cycle_autoscale_group.by_identifier.scale.up.maximum
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the auto-scale group. Exactly one of `id` or `identifier` must be set.
- `identifier` (String) The human-readable slugged identifier of the auto-scale group. Exactly one of `id` or `identifier` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `cluster` (String) The identifier of the cluster this auto-scale group belongs to.
- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this auto-scale group belongs to.
- `infrastructure` (Attributes List) Server models Cycle may provision from. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--infrastructure))
- `name` (String) The user-defined name of the auto-scale group.
- `scale` (Attributes) Scale-up and scale-down bounds for the group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scale))
- `state` (String) The current state of the auto-scale group.

<a id="nestedatt--infrastructure"></a>
### Nested Schema for `infrastructure`

Read-Only:

- `integration_id` (String) The provider integration ID associated with this model.
- `locations` (Attributes List) Locations this model may be provisioned in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--infrastructure--locations))
- `model_id` (String) The provider server model ID.
- `priority` (Number) Relative priority of this model.
- `provider` (String) The infrastructure provider identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--infrastructure--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `infrastructure.locations`

Read-Only:

- `availability_zones` (List of String) Availability zones within the location.
- `id` (String) The provider location ID.



<a id="nestedatt--scale"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scale`

Read-Only:

- `down` (Attributes) Scale-down settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scale--down))
- `up` (Attributes) Scale-up settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scale--up))

<a id="nestedatt--scale--down"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scale.down`

Read-Only:

- `inactivity_period` (String) How long after the last instance is deployed before a server is eligible for deletion.
- `method` (String) Which server to remove first when scaling down (`fifo` or `lifo`).
- `min_ttl` (String) Minimum time-to-live for a server provisioned by an autoscale event.


<a id="nestedatt--scale--up"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scale.up`

Read-Only:

- `maximum` (Number) Maximum number of servers this group may provision.
